name: Beauty and Brains
brief: We were asked to revise one of our two-page comics to be printed in a class collection.  In this case, revising meant to change as much as you wanted, but the bare minimum was to add a title and byline, as well as made sure our comic strictly adhered to the 1/4-inch margins (for optimal printing).

name: Biographical Comic
brief: This was part of the class's 2-page comic series, this one being biographical, albeit up to our interpretation.  We could tell the story of someone's life, a moment in someone's life, or even reinterpret moments of someone's life/put an existing person into a new situation.
description: For my comic, I chose to make mine about Hedy Lamarr, whose story I first learned when I did a research project on her in 8th grade.  Most of the information in this comic is completely true (although there are different accounts of how she left her husband in Austria, I just chose a specific one to draw).

name: Longform Comic
brief: This was my final project for the class, an 8+ page comic.
description: The story here is to be continued, a hypothetical first chapter of a longer graphic novel that ends on a cliff hanger.  I was inspired by a one-off line from a TV show, and created this, 9 pages that barely scratch the surface of the story I want to tell.

name: Character Comic
brief: This was part of the class's 2-page comic series, a comic focusing on developing characters through action.

name: Poetry Comic
brief: This was part of the class's 2-page comic series, focusing on poetry in a comic medium, with a very loose potential interpretation.

name: Autobiographical Comic
brief: This was part of the class's 2-page comic series, one based on our own experiences, where it was up to us on how reality-based our comic was.

name: 6-9 Panel Comic
brief: We had to create a single page comic, with either six or nine panels, all equal in size, with the story completely up to us.

name: 4 Panel Comic
brief: We had to create a four panel comic of 2in x 2in squares, story up to us

name: Single Panel Comic 1
brief: This was our first assignment, two single panel comics with limited text in the page, and an optional caption below.

name: Single Panel Comic 2
brief: This was our first assignment, two single panel comics with limited text in the page, and an optional caption below.
